scope: Prospective expanded RecFlow development: fresh six-layer base and five daily updates, fixed candidate-ranking primary; no formal release admission or final-role evaluation.
authorization: The user explicitly requests more users, the established six-layer stable configuration, small canary checks, three or five daily updates with next-day evaluation, and immediate detached tmux launch followed by handoff without waiting for completion.
population: Fixed first4096 of4569 development-role users with at least1024 real exposures by D18, ordered by the existing stable_hash(uid,1818). Contains the old512-user cohort as an exact prefix. No future-activity, coverage or outcome filter. Other UID roles remain untouched. Frozen initial1M catalog is unchanged and independent of selected cohort size.
training: Train a fresh A from seed17 on every eligible D1-18 request for three full epochs, then B-F each on one complete next day for one epoch. One sampled known positive per eligible request, no request cap, real final batches and inherited model plus AdamW. Do not initialize from the512-user model or canary. A final endpoint is epoch3; each update endpoint is epoch1. Fixed training-only NLL is recorded each epoch, and every endpoint is retained.
evaluation: Check A on D19, then A/B on D20, B/C on D21, C/D on D22, D/E on D23, E/F on D24. For primary candidate ranking, freeze6144 positive requests per day using the existing request/UID hash salts, scaling the old768 panel with population size. Rank every known positive plus1000 uniform distractors by normalized joint generative probability. Parent/current share exact requests, candidates and OOV denominators. Keep complete next-day free beam300 metrics and popularity1000/NDCG20/100/Recall companions under their own panels. Report actual test-user coverage and all relative improvement percentages.
working_rule: Base and each parent/current must reach at least twice their own matched uniform-random expectation and exceed the5000-trial99th percentile; each current should exceed its parent on that same next-day panel. No preferred gain band, no future outcome changes to K, candidate pool, users or training schedule. Keep every failed, negative or large outcome.
continuation_rule: This is a predeclared descriptive development training chain. Quality failures are reported and all five planned updates still run. Numerical nonfinite loss/gradients, data-causality, panel, checkpoint or optimizer-lineage mismatch stop execution. These fixed endpoints are not serving releases and do not automatically unlock Reuse or admit phi models.
canary: Before the long run, execute the actual4096-user/catalog six-layer runner on tiny263-request A and B passes, with real four-rank optimizer inheritance and tiny next-day scoring/random comparison. Verify actual saved optimizer steps0->3->6 and LR0.001, finite losses/metrics, all full training-window known hashes and nonempty rank tails. CPU checks cover all E/F date/predecessor mappings. Existing actual-generator unequal-tail numerical and known-positive resident-evaluation canaries cover unchanged scoring math. Canary outcomes never qualify recommendation quality.

resource_estimate.basis: Measured6L four-rank training~338requests/s and recent full9039+sample768 evaluation~360s per checkpoint. Expanded full request counts and6144 sampled requests retain similar sample density. Allow startup, NLL, checkpoint and random-analysis overhead. This is an estimate, not a completion guarantee.
resource_estimate.storage: About14.2GB for six final model+AdamW endpoints, plus4.8GB temporary A epoch1/2 checkpoints and small logs/raw metrics. Remove only unused initial intermediate/canary weights after their evidence is retained.
resource_estimate.execution: One serial four-rank DDP phase at a time; four independent evaluation workers share GPUs only while training ranks wait on CPU Gloo. Run the complete chain in detached tmux with per-command logs, exit status, progress and cumulative reports. No Yambda job or assets are changed.
